headline: United States GP: Austin media day, one day to Friday practice
whyCareReason: Paddock media day Thursday at COTA. Friday practice begins tomorrow. Antonelli leads Russell by 102.
teaser: Austin media briefings Thursday. Friday practice opens tomorrow. Mercedes lead Ferrari by 134.
story: Thursday 22 October brought driver press conferences and media briefings to the Circuit of the Americas paddock, one day before practice begins for the United States Grand Prix. Formula1.com lists Free Practice 1 and Sprint Qualifying for Friday, 23 October, followed by the Sprint and Qualifying on Saturday, and the 56-lap Grand Prix on Sunday, 25 October at 15:00 local time. Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli holds a 102-point lead over George Russell (340 to 238) in the drivers' championship. Mercedes lead Ferrari 578 to 444 in the constructors' standings. No cars run competitively on Thursday.
stakes: The American triple-header opens in Austin with 102 points separating the top two drivers. Six races remain in 2026.
rivalryAngle: Media day sets the stage before practice commences Friday at COTA.
funFacts: Thursday media day complete. Practice 1 begins Friday 23 October at COTA.
Circuit: 5.513 km, 56 laps, 308.405 km. Race start Sunday 15:00 local time.

keyPlayers.name: Kimi Antonelli
keyPlayers.hook: Leads the drivers' championship with 340 points, 102 ahead of Russell.

keyPlayers.name: George Russell
keyPlayers.hook: Second on 238 points after climbing from 19th to ninth in Singapore.

headToHead: No Austin session has been run. Singapore remains the last classified race.
resultSummary: UPCOMING: Austin weekend 23-25 October. Practice Friday. Antonelli leads by 102.
